articles.summary: Led by real estate entrepreneur Matt Clayton, the Florida-based team is expanding into New York, serving all five boroughs The Real Brokerage Inc., a leading technology-enabled real estate platform redefining the industry through innovation and agent culture, today announced that Clayton Coastal Group has joined the company. The move brings 37 agents to Real, expands its presence across Florida and sets the stage for the team’s expansion into New York, serving all five boroughs. Led by Matt Clayton, Clayton Coastal Group is on pace to close nearly $300 million in real estate transactions this year, after building a highly successful business fueled by social media, digital marketing and a focus on serving out-of-town buyers. Clayton personally closes approximately $50 million in annual transaction volume. articles.title: Clayton Coastal Group Joins The Real Brokerage, Bringing 37 Agents and Nearly $300 Million in Annual Sales Volume
